tools.name: tavily_news_search
tools.description: Search for recent news articles from the last 7 days with recency prioritization. Use for: breaking news, earnings announcements, credit rating actions, market events, regulatory updates. Prefer over web_search for any time-sensitive query.

max_results.description: Maximum number of news articles to return

tools.name: tavily_domain_search
tools.description: Search within specific trusted domains for authoritative financial intelligence. Use for: credit ratings (moodys.com, spglobal.com, fitchratings.com), regulators (sec.gov, federalreserve.gov, bis.org), financial news (bloomberg.com, reuters.com, ft.com, wsj.com), filings (edgar.sec.gov). Always prefer this over general search when a specific authoritative source is appropriate.

include_domains.description: List of domains to search within. For financial intelligence use: bloomberg.com, reuters.com, ft.com, wsj.com, sec.gov, moodys.com, spglobal.com, fitchratings.com, federalreserve.gov, bis.org

exclude_domains.description: List of domains to exclude from search (e.g., ['pinterest.com', 'facebook.com'])

tools.name: tavily_web_search
tools.description: Broad web search for general queries when no specific domain is known. Use as a last resort — prefer tavily_news_search for recent events, tavily_domain_search for financial/regulatory sources, tavily_research_search for deep analysis.

query.description: Search query to find web information

search_depth.description: Depth of search - 'basic' for quick results, 'advanced' for comprehensive search

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return

tools.name: tavily_research_search
tools.description: Deep research search for comprehensive financial analysis, regulatory filings, academic/professional content requiring broad coverage. Use for: annual reports, industry studies, macro analysis, technical deep-dives. Prefer over web_search when depth matters.

topic.description: Research topic category for optimized results

max_results.description: Maximum number of results (higher for research)

include_raw_content.description: Include full HTML content for deeper analysis

tools.name: duckdb_query
tools.description: Run a read-only SQL query over DuckDB views.

tools.description: Look up approved credit limits for a counterparty.
